caseName: New York Scaffolding Co. v. Whitney
caseNameFull: New York Scaffolding Company v. George R. Whitney, Sr., as Administrator, etc.

opinions.text: November 8, 1920. Petition for a writ of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Eighth Circuit denied. Announced by Mr. Justice McKenna. Mr. Frank Chase Somes and Mr. C. P. Goepel for petitioner. Mr. Wallace R. Lane and Mr. Robert H• Parkinson for respondent. See ante, 24, 32.
